name: Tragacanth
aliases: E413, INS 413, tragacanth, gum tragacanth, tragacanth gum
what_is: A plant gum obtained from Astragalus species and used as a thickener, stabiliser and emulsifying texturiser, identified in the EU as E413.
why_botia: Tragacanth is a plant resin that swells in water and thickens. It has been used since ancient times in confectionery and pharmacy, and it is one of the most expensive gums, so it appears in specific products. The body does not digest it. The label tells you it is there, not how much it contains.
